blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (SQL injection through the search term) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence: const sql = "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%" + term + "%' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50";
findings.recommendation: The `q` query-string parameter of `GET /users/search` (src/server.ts:13) is only trimmed and length-checked (2 to 100 characters), then concatenated into the SQL text. Any caller holding the `support` role can send `q=' UNION SELECT id, password_hash FROM users --` (or any other table) and read arbitrary data, or alter the query, through the endpoint (CWE-89). Bind the term as a parameter through the existing helper, which `src/db.ts` documents as "values go in `params`, never in `sql`": `query<UserRow>("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE $1 ESCAPE '\\' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50", ["%" + escaped + "%"])`, where `escaped` escapes `\`, `%` and `_` in the term so that user wildcards match literally. Add a test showing that a term containing a quote is matched literally and does not break the query.
findings.title: SQL injection through the search term
